armGroups.label: Ublituximab + Oral Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants received ublituximab intravenous (IV) infusion, 150 milligrams (mg) over 4 hours (h) on Day 1 followed by 450 mg over 1 h on Days 15, 168, 336 and 504 (Week 72) along with the oral placebo tablet, once daily (QD) from Day 1 up to the last day of Week 95.

armGroups.label: Teriflunomide + IV Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants received teriflunomide 14 mg tablet, orally, QD from Day 1 up to the last day of Week 95 along with the placebo IV infusion on Days 1, 15, 168, 336 and 504 (Week 72).

participantFlowModule.preAssignmentDetails: A total of 629 participants were screened and of those, 545 were enrolled and randomized to receive either ublituximab/oral placebo or teriflunomide/IV placebo.
participantFlowModule.recruitmentDetails: A total of 545 participants were enrolled across investigative sites in Belarus, Spain, the United Kingdom, Croatia, Poland, Russia, Ukraine, and the United States from 25 August 2017 to 12 November 2020.
